definitions.explanation: Thread or yarn spun from the cocoons of silkworms. Used for fine sewing, embroidery, weaving silk fabrics, and traditional crafts.

examples.japanese: {絹糸|きぬいと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{刺繍|ししゅう}→刺繍：05411_shishuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I did embroidery with silk thread.

examples.japanese: ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{絹糸|きぬいと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{織|お}られている→織る：04373_oru⟧。
examples.english: The kimono is woven with silk thread.

examples.japanese: ⟦{蚕|かいこ}→蚕：21218_kaiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{繭|まゆ}→繭：13861_mayu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{細|ほそ}い→細い：02962_hosoi⟧{絹糸|きぬいと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: Fine silk thread is obtained from the cocoons that silkworms make.

notes:
⟦{絹|きぬ}→絹：01383_kinu⟧ (silk) + ⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧ (thread). Also occasionally read けんし in technical contexts (e.g., the textile industry).
